notes: Sources opened with WebFetch only; URLs found through WebSearch. No official national or regional duty rota ('veterinários de serviço') and no animal poison line were found: the OMV page on the Bragança rotating emergency service could not be fetched (server error), and the INEM CIAV page (800 250 250) describes a 24 h service for professionals and the public but never mentions animals, so CIAV was NOT listed as a poison line. FMV-ULisboa Hospital Escolar (hospital.fmv.ulisboa.pt) and Hospital Veterinário de Leiria (hvleiria.pt) blocked by robots; Leiria taken from the Onevet group listing. Also unreachable/refused: hospitalvetloule.pt, hospitalveterinariodoalgarve.pt, vetalbufeira.com.pt, centroveterinariodolima.pt, almavet.pt, hvv.pt, evidensia Guimarães page, hospitalveterinariodeportimao.com urgências subpage. unavets.com listing sub-pages were not usable as sources. Onevet group entries marked 'unit page not opened' rely on the group's own unit listing. Left to do: Hospital Veterinário do Porto, Lagos/PetVet Lagos, Hospital de Loulé (24 h per secondary reports only), Ponta Delgada/other Azores islands out-of-hours, Évora/Setúbal other clinics, Viana do Castelo 24 h hospital, Vetmedis (Madeira) per-clinic hours, DGAV CAMV register (dgav.pt, April 2026 PDF, licensing only), Faro/Lisbon non-24 h small-animal clinics, Bragança rota.
